title: Attractive clear organizer to hang on a wall or put in a drawer; a bit fragile - 2.5 stars
text:
Attractive clear organizer to hang on a wall or put in a drawer; a bit fragile - 2.5 stars. This is a simple, basic, understated but nice four-compartment Ziplock bag organizer with one opening each for different types of bags such as quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. This can be hung on the wall or be placed in a drawer that is large enough to hold it. There are four screws and plastic mollies provided for hanging and also four stick-on hooks. The organizer has a hinged front and opens easily as it is held together by small magnets in the corner.

Overall, this is an attractive organizer that sort of fades into the background since it is clear. It also does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. It is definitely an attractive unit even though it is acrylic. However, this is super fragile and does feel like it would break if dropped or handled roughly. I also wish they provided some rubberized "circles" on the bottom to keep it from sliding around in a drawer or scratching a wall. It is due to the fragility of the unit and the lackluster closure of the magnets that I rate this 2.5 stars rounded up to 3 stars.

The current price of $24.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for this, especially since it is thin and breakable. Other options that are available for organizers like this are this [[ASIN:B09D5Y63D1 one]] if one is looking for four separate compartments. For a variety of organizers (separate and one unit), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]]. For a larger unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires.

product_metadata.title: Ziplock Bag Storage Organizer for Drawer Acrylic Baggie Organizer Plastic Bag Dispenser Holder Food Storage Bag Organizer Compatible With Ziploc, Solimo, Glad, Hefty For Gallon, Quart, Sandwich And Snack Variety Size Bags
features: Product size: 12.5 x 12.5 x 3.7 inches, please make sure it fits where you need it before placing an order

Acrylic baggie organizer - It is made of clear high-quality acrylic, which is hard and light-transmitting and easy to clean. The lid is openable and fits easily into a plastic bag, and there are magnets in the sealed corners to keep it closed securely

Space manager - Use it to keep your Dawer clutter free, you can place 4 different types of ziplock bags to keep your drawers neater and free up more space for other items. There are 4 mounting holes on the back, you can also hang it on the wall for use
Compatible with most brand bags - The acrylic organizer has 4 compartments to store storage bags of various sizes, it is compatible with brands like Ziploc, Solimo, Hefty, Glad and more
Easy to use: Bag storage organizer does not need to be assembled by itself. Simply place the food organizer in the box as indicated by the stamped label
